name: Puritan Medical Products
old_description: Puritan Medical Products is an American family-owned company. We're known worldwide as the most trusted manufacturer of swabs and single-use specimen collection devices for healthcare, diagnostics, forensics, controlled environments and environmental sciences.
about:
Puritan Medical Products, founded in 1919 as Hardwood Products Company, operates from Guilford, Maine. The family-owned business rebranded to Puritan Medical Products Company I, LP in January 2023. It began producing single-use items from Northern white birch and evolved into a specialized manufacturer of swabs and specimen collection devices.

The company runs three manufacturing facilities in Maine — Guilford and two in Pittsfield — where it produces swabs, applicators, and single-use medical devices. Capabilities include flocked swab production, custom fill of transport media, an on-site microbiology lab staffed with microbiologists, a state-of-the-art print shop for labeling and packaging, and full R&D prototyping. The Guilford plant uses 100% renewable energy from wood process waste; overall facilities achieve 35% renewable energy. Puritan is an FDA-registered medical device manufacturer since 1978 and holds ISO and CE Mark certifications.

Products serve diagnostics, forensics and genetics, environmental testing, microbiology media, medical, and controlled environments. Customers include distributors, kit manufacturers, OEM partners, and direct buyers through a new D2C channel. Custom projects typically start at 100,000 units, with NDA-protected development, prototype sampling, and custom bar coding.

Puritan emphasizes USA-made manufacturing, consistent quality, and environmental stewardship — recycling 100% of paper, cardboard, and metal waste. Its differentiation rests on integrated in-house capabilities from formulation to packaging, enabling rapid customization for emerging disease detection and bioterrorism testing.
